name: revenue-bar
title: Revenue Bar
description: See your Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad and Paddle revenue in one dashboard and in your menu bar.
author: felitrejos

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: View Revenue Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Today, last 7 days, last 30 days and month-to-date revenue, per provider and combined.

commands.name: recent-sales
commands.title: View Recent Sales
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Latest orders across your payment providers.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Revenue Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Show revenue for a chosen range in the menu bar. Requires Revenue Bar Pro.

preferences.name: menuBarRange
preferences.title: Range
preferences.description: Which revenue range the menu bar title shows.

preferences.name: menuBarShowProviderBreakdown
preferences.title: Provider Breakdown
preferences.label: Show a line per provider in the menu
preferences.description: Show the revenue of each provider in the dropdown.

commands.name: subscriptions
commands.title: View Subscriptions
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: MRR, active subscriptions, and new and churned subscriptions this month. Requires Revenue Bar Pro.

commands.name: refunds
commands.title: View Refunds and Disputes
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Refunds, disputes and chargebacks from the last 30 days. Requires Revenue Bar Pro.

commands.name: search-customers
commands.title: Search Customers
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Find a customer by email across providers and see their orders and subscriptions. Requires Revenue Bar Pro.

commands.name: export-csv
commands.title: Export Sales to CSV
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Export the sales of the selected dashboard range to a CSV file in Downloads. Requires Revenue Bar Pro.

commands.name: manage-license
commands.title: Manage License
commands.subtitle: Revenue Bar
commands.description: Check, validate or deactivate your Revenue Bar Pro license key.

preferences.name: stripeApiKey
preferences.title: Stripe Restricted API Key
preferences.description: A read-only restricted key (rk_live_...). See the README for the permissions to enable.

preferences.name: lemonSqueezyApiKey
preferences.title: Lemon Squeezy API Key
preferences.description: Create one in Lemon Squeezy under Settings > API.

preferences.name: gumroadAccessToken
preferences.title: Gumroad Access Token
preferences.description: Generate one in Gumroad under Settings > Advanced > Applications.

preferences.name: paddleApiKey
preferences.title: Paddle API Key
preferences.description: A Paddle Billing API key with read permissions (pdl_live_apikey_...).

preferences.name: paddleEnvironment
preferences.title: Paddle Environment
preferences.description: Live or sandbox. Keys that contain live_ or sdbx_ select their environment automatically.

preferences.name: displayCurrency
preferences.title: Display Currency
preferences.description: Three-letter currency code used for combined totals. Other currencies are converted with daily ECB rates.

preferences.name: defaultRange
preferences.title: Default Range
preferences.description: The range the dashboard opens with.

preferences.name: licenseKey
preferences.title: Revenue Bar Pro License Key
preferences.description: Optional. Unlocks all providers, the menu bar, subscriptions, refunds, customer search and CSV export.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
